title: Fix the Broken Landing Page
description: Put your diagnostic skills to the test in a real-world debugging challenge. Locate and fix markup syntax errors, broken layout styles, and a crashing JavaScript button handler.

objectives.statement: Identify the cause of rendering and script failures using systematic inspection.
Correct DOM hierarchy, CSS properties, and JavaScript references to restore page functionality.

content.title: Mission: Repair the Launch Page
content.hook: A teammate pushed code right before the product launch, but the page layout is broken and the subscribe button throws errors.
content.context: Your task is to diagnose three distinct defects (HTML nesting, CSS display collision, and a JavaScript null reference) and fix them.
goals: Find and fix broken closing tags in HTML.
Fix a runtime JavaScript error in an event listener.

content.title: Bug 1: Malformed Form Markup
content.prompt: Inspect the buggy HTML form below. Fix the broken tag nesting and invalid void element closing tag.
content.bugDescription: The input element has an invalid closing tag and the submit button is unclosed.
content.buggyCode:
<form class="newsletter-form">
  <label for="email-input">Your Email:</label>
  <input id="email-input" type="email" placeholder="engineer@example.com"></input>
  <button type="submit">Subscribe
</form>
hints: <input> is a void element and must not have a closing </input> tag.
The <button> tag needs a closing </button> tag before </form>.

feedback.correct: Bug resolved! <input> has no closing tag, and <button> is properly closed.
feedback.incorrect: Review void elements and tag matching: remove </input> and ensure </button> is present.

content.question: The hero banner is invisible despite having content. The CSS contains: .hero { opacity: 0; display: block; }. What is the immediate fix to make it visible?

options.hint: Opacity 0 renders an element completely transparent.

options.text: Change display: block to display: none

options.hint: Negative z-index puts elements behind other layers.
Position static does not alter opacity.

content.explanation: opacity: 0 makes the element 100% transparent. Changing it to opacity: 1 makes it fully visible.

feedback.correct: Correct! Restoring opacity to 1 makes the banner visible.
feedback.incorrect: Think about why an element with display: block might still be invisible: check opacity.

content.title: Bug 3: JavaScript Null Reference
content.prompt: The script below fails with 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading addEventListener)'. Fix the selector so it attaches to the existing button with id='submit-btn'.

feedback.correct: Great catch! Matching getElementById('submit-btn') connects the handler cleanly.

content.prompt: Describe the 3-step checklist you would use in DevTools when a user reports that clicking a button does nothing.
guidelines: Mention Console tab for error inspection.
Mention Elements tab for event listeners and DOM presence.
Mention Network tab or state checks.
content.sampleResponse: 1. Check Console tab for uncaught exceptions. 2. Inspect the element in DevTools to ensure it exists and has listeners attached. 3. Verify event handler logic.

content.title: Challenge Complete!
content.message: You successfully diagnosed and repaired all frontend defects across HTML structure, CSS transparency, and JavaScript event delegation.
content.congratulations: Congratulations on completing your first full-stack frontend debugging challenge!
